input: Naturalism is the neutral default: only scientific authority counts, simpler ontology wins, and religious claims inherit an impossible implication chain.

bridge_terms.D0: The surface discourse presents naturalism as default, scientific authority as tribunal, ontological parsimony as decisive, and religious entailments as overloaded.
bridge_terms.PsiN: The encoded state preserves the non-Trinitarian register mix before owner-plan emission.
bridge_terms.selected_N: The selected frame is naturalism/default-carrier pressure; it is not a Trinitarian or named theological template.
bridge_terms.expanded_IR: IR(N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa) derives the burden floor from live_registers(IR(...)) for this naturalism N-frame.
bridge_terms.Omega: The parsimony/default-ontology pressure requires an ontological burden.
bridge_terms.xi: The scientific-authority tribunal requires a warrant/authority burden.
bridge_terms.mu: Naturalism-as-default functions as a memetic carrier that must be decomposed before evidence routes release.
bridge_terms.kappa: The implication-chain pressure requires dependency/collapse accounting.
bridge_terms.register_burden_floor: The same register-derived floor rule works outside the Trinitarian John 17:3 canary.

control_effects.hold_release: Hold evidence-bank release until the authority tribunal and default-carrier pressure are decomposed.
control_effects.burden_selection: Select register-typed naturalism burdens from live xi, mu, Omega, and kappa rather than from a named case floor.
control_effects.reread: After the default-carrier burden lands, reread whether evidence routes become eligible or remain absorbed by the carrier.

register_to_burden_obligation.derivation: burden_floor = {B_r : r in live_registers(IR(N,m,tau,sigma,heart,xi,Omega,mu,kappa))}; the naturalism N-frame supplies label content.

burden_floor.label: scientific-authority-tribunal / naturalism-as-default-carrier
burden_floor.register_operation: decompose the default carrier and authority tribunal before evidence release
burden_floor.local_delta: Delta(B1): default carrier unpacked into warrant, ontology, and implication-chain pressures
burden_floor.land_contribution: Contribution-to-Land(B1): lands carrier decomposition so evidence release is no longer governed by the compressed default

burden_floor.label: ontological-parsimony-claim
burden_floor.register_operation: test whether parsimony is functioning as ontology rather than neutral method

burden_floor.label: implication-chain
burden_floor.register_operation: trace downstream entailments before collapse or closure

ir_projection.load_bearing_node: Naturalism content fills labels, while live register state supplies the floor structure.
ir_projection.what_is_withheld_and_why: Evidence lists and downstream doctrine comparison are held until the default-carrier and authority tribunal pressures are decomposed.

post_render_gate.cleared_this_pass: the naturalism floor source is register liveness rather than a named case template
post_render_gate.remaining_live_distortions: evidence routes may remain held if the default-carrier pressure still absorbs them
post_render_gate.next_eligible_pass: test broadened evidence routes after xi/mu reread
